dz: 经过数周的轰炸后,的黎波里市落入了Qalawun统治下的马姆卢克人手中。 马姆卢克人屠杀了他们找到的所有男人,奴役了妇女和儿童.
de: Following weeks of bombardment, the city of Tripoli falls to the Mamluks under Qalawun. The Mamluks massacre all men they find and enslave the women and children.
